_comment: Inspection outcomes used by the app and the report. Add entries to extend; never reuse or rename an id that is already in saved batch files.

modes.label: Pass
modes.description: Structure present and cleared as intended

modes.label: Skating
modes.description: Resist ends up as an isolated line instead of an isolated trench for metallization

_colors: Colors validated as a set (all-pairs, light surface). Every mark also shows its key letter, so status never relies on color alone.
_resist: Modes with "resist": true are resist (masking) failures; the report relates them to the thin resist features.
